title: Sleep and your mizaj
caption:
Still awake? This one's for you.

Unani tradition links sleep with temperament. Some mizaj sleep like a rock and wake up groggy; some replay every argument at midnight; some sleep lightly and think heavily. Here's what tradition suggests for each.

Traditional wellness habits, not medical advice. Ongoing sleep trouble deserves a visit to a doctor or hakeem.

What time did you actually sleep last night? Be honest.
